summary_md: **Shohdy Elsheemy ([@shohdi2](https://x.com/shohdi2/status/2116619052403552538))** built **Relic Drift**, a playable Unity game whose 3D assets came from Speridlabs' Idol via his own C# inference port, with gameplay coded using Codex ([speridlabs/idol](https://huggingface.co/speridlabs/idol), [shohdi/idol-csharp](https://github.com/shohdi/idol-csharp), [play](https://www.osiristoken.com/RelicDrift/index.html)).

referenced_urls.title: GitHub - shohdi/idol-csharp: Local C# desktop implementation of Speridlabs Idol image-to-3D Gaussian splats with an orbit viewer and Unity export. No Python runtime.

relevance: AI-generated 3D assets to a playable game.
